Yes, you can cancel an order after placing it if it has not yet shipped. To do this, submit a cancellation request as soon as possible after placing the order. Once the cancellation is confirmed, the refund is issued to your original payment method. 
If the order has already shipped and is in transit, it cannot be canceled while on the way. In that case, you may refuse delivery (if the courier allows it) or return the item after it arrives.
For cancellation requests, send a message to care@nurosym.com as soon as possible.

st now

Refuse delivery if the courier allows it, or
Accept the package and request a return after delivery.
